programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety

programme.title: Last of the Right Whales

From the only known calving grounds to the shifting feeding grounds, ‘Last of the Right Whales' follows the North Atlantic right whale migration and the people committed to saving a species still struggling to recover from centuries of hunting.

programme.title: Fertile Floods
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Rivers and Lakes
programme.desc: Water is the beginning of all life - including the wildlife of Germany. Beavers fell trees, otters play under water, kingfishers catch fish for their young. Lakes and rivers cover just 2.5% of the total area of the country. The episode Rivers and Lakes takes the viewer on a journey through the water world of Germany. In winter, the few ice-free surfaces are popular with waterfowl. Coots throng the source ponds of the River Havel, while above them white-tailed eagles gather for the hunt, as their prey swim openly beneath them. The coots stick together, swimming to and fro to make it difficult for the eagles to pick out one individual bird. But with each attack, the coots grow increasingly tired. In Spring, the ice melts and the lakes and rivers awake from their winter torpor. Germany has more than 800 rivers longer than 10km. They transport the life-giving liquid into all corners of the country. The water of the River Danube alone would be enough to fill Germany's biggest body of water, Lake Constance, in 12 months. Every year, six times the volume of the lake falls in the form of precipitation: 800 litres per square metre. Otters and beavers had a very hard time in recent centuries. They were hunted mercilessly for their fur and eaten in periods of fasting. Today, both species are protected and their populations are recovering.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Car the Garden! This artist made his big debut in the music industry in 2013 under the name Mason the Soul. Then in 2017 he changed his stage name to Car the Garden a literal translation of his name Cha Jeong-won and pleasantly surprised everyone in indie circles with his unique voice and dream-like sounds. The following year he became the final winner of the fan-voting audition program The Fan and further secured his position in the industry. Last month Car the Garden released his much-anticipated new album Absence. Featuring 5 tracks the album is filled with his distinct warm sounds and also showcases his growth as a musician. In this episode Car the Garden performs Tree Sarah and Home Sweet Home as well asMy Whole World and Doesn't Matter from his latest album. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer with a heartrending voice... Yang Da Il! This artist garnered much attention even before his official debut by taking part in Jung Key's songs Be Forgotten and This Intense Moment in 2011 as a guest vocalist. 4 years later in 2015 Yang Da Il made his official debut with the single Think and engraved his name in the minds of the public with his iconic heartrending voice. In January this year Yang Da Il released his second full-length album our joys and sadnesses to depict love and breakups. His new songs dominated the top spots of music charts and proved once again how beloved he is as a musician. In this episode Yang Da Il performs Loss Darling Sometimes Hurt and Sorry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy his depiction of love and separation!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is R&B musician Babylon! This artist made his big debut in 2015 with the single PRAY and immediately captured listeners' hearts with his unusual soulful vibes. Then he engraved his names in the minds of the public by featuring in ZICO's Boys And Girls which led him to collaborate with a number of top artists in the industry including Verbal Zint The Quiett Nucksal BewhY Suzy Chungha Yubin and more. This February Babylon returned to the industry with his much-anticipated new album Hardy packed to the brim with collaborations and songs. One of the lead singles Alone was written composed and produced by Lee Hyo-ri and another lead single Like Song features top rapper Jay Park. Babylon also worked with Kid Milli Coogie KYLE LO Samuel Seo Lee Young-ji Queen WA$ABII and more for the album. In this episode Babylon performs Like Song Dawn Fog Chandelier Red Lipstick and White Suit to showcase the essence of his musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band MACGUFFIN! This band is composed of drummer SNOOQ vocalist and guitarist Byeon Ha-geum bassist UHI and guitarist Bae Joon-il. The band is named after a technique of the same name that advances a film's plot builds the narrative and helps push the story forward widely popularized by Alfred Hitchcock. Back in 2017 the quartet participated in the Arirang Competition and won the Grand Prize with their unique interpretation of Arirang. Then in 2018 they won the Golden Prize at the Penta Super Rookie and engraved their name in the minds of the public. The members recently completed their mandatory military duties and are so ready to impress listeners with their matured musicality. In this episode MACGUFFIN performs Sinpa Bucket List Highway and more to showcase their artistic prowess. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Letti sbagliati
programme.desc: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Raimondo Vianello e Aldo Giuffrè in una commedia scoppiettante. Quattro divertenti episodi che ruotano intorno al piacere: due sono ambientati in un treno, all'interno del quale si verificano eventi indimenticabili, uno in un caldo ascensore bloccato e l'ultimo riguarda un vedovo, ossessionato dal precedente matrimonio.

programme.title: Sei iellato amico hai incontrato Sacramento
programme.desc: Affascinante Western magistralmente condotto da Giorgio Cristallini. Questa storia dal ritmo incalzante ruota attorno al rapimento della figlia di un pugile. Il pugile paga il riscatto, ma la ragazza non viene ancora rilasciata. Il fidanzato decide di riprendersela a modo suo, uccidendo lo spietato rapitore in un feroce duello.

programme.title: Il debito coniugale
programme.desc: Romolo, benzinaio presso il distributore della ricca moglie Ines, un giorno incontra Orazio, suo ex commilitone andato per caso a fare benzina da lui, e viene convinto a fuggire via dalla noia della vita coniugale per vivere d'espedienti.

programme.title: Per favore, occupati di Amelia
programme.desc: Monsignor Florio, arcivescovo di Rio de Janeiro, si precipita a Roma perché Marcello, suo figlio illegittimo, ha manifestato l'intenzione di sposarsi. In realtà si tratta di uno stratagemma per tentare di estorcere al genitore un anticipo sull'eredità. Amelia, una mondana d'alto bordo, regge il gioco di Marcello. Ma chi la fa, l'aspetti!

programme.title: L'automobile
programme.desc: Anna Mastronardi (Anna Magnani) è una matura ex-prostituta diventata un'istituzione per la vita notturna romana, tanto che si fa chiamare contessa. D'altro canto la donna si sente sola e senza scopi. Decide quindi di comprarsi un'automobile per trovare un nuovo interesse, per soddisfare il suo bisogno di sentirsi una donna realizzata e per mettersi in evidenza di fronte a tutta Via Veneto.

programme.title: Pellegrini d'amore
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia con la celebre Sophia Loren. Durante l'immediato dopoguerra, la contessa Dalia gestisce una bisca clandestina in una villa. Fra i vari clienti, ci sono anche due ricchi ex-ufficiali statunitensi che s'invaghiscono di una bella sconosciuta ritratta in un dipinto dell'abitazione. Dalia decide allora di sfruttare al meglio la situazione attuando un piano molto particolare.

programme.title: Miseria e nobiltà
programme.desc: Due famiglie poverissime vengono ingaggiate da un giovane marchese per fingersi aristocratiche e favorire il suo matrimonio con la figlia di un ricco cuoco. La messinscena degenera in una travolgente farsa.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e la… Malafemmina
programme.desc: Un giovane napoletano si innamora di una soubrette e decide di seguirla a Milano. Gli zii Totò e Peppino partono per riportarlo a casa, ma il viaggio al Nord diventa una memorabile catena di equivoci.

programme.title: Giorni d'amore
programme.desc: Due giovani paesani, Angela e Pasquale, dovrebbero sposarsi, ma non hanno i mezzi per affrontare le spese delle nozze. La soluzione suggerita dai genitori è: se Pasquale rapisse Angela, la ragazza sarebbe compromessa e s`imporrebbe il classico matrimonio riparatore, al quale non si addice nesusna fastosa cerimonia...

programme.title: Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: Due terroristi entrano in un laboratorio dove si sperimentano armi batteriologiche prodotte dai servizi segreti e contraggono un terribile virus. Uno dei due riesce a fuggire e a salire sul treno per Stoccolma dove contagia alcuni passeggeri. Ma i servizi segreti rintracciano il convoglio e decidono di deviarlo verso la Polonia. Lo scopo è farlo precipitare su un ponte pericolante il Cassandra Crossing, in modo che tutti muoiano e si perdano le tracce del terribile segreto...

programme.title: Cronaca di un amore
programme.desc: Enrico, vittima di una immotivata gelosia nei confronti del passato sentimentale della moglie Paola, assolda un investigatore per capire se gli fedele. Questo atteggiamento spinge Paola tra le braccia di Guido, uomo di cui era innamorata in passato. Inevitabilmente, tra i due scoppia una pericolosa e travolgente passione...

programme.title: Il corsaro nero
programme.desc: Il capitano Black un pirata coraggioso e affascinante, alla guida della sua ciurma decide di assaltare la nave che porta l`oro dalle colonie spagnole alla madrepatria. Quando scopre che la nave non trasporta oro, ma la moglie del viceré della colonia, Black decide di rapirla per chiedere l`oro in riscatto. Anche Skull vuole l`oro, si allea così con altri pirati nemici di Black per sottrargli la donna..

programme.title: Noi siamo la marea
programme.desc: Quindici anni fa l'oceano è sparito dalla costa di Windholm, in Germania. E così pure i bambini del luogo. Il giovane fisico Micha vorrebbe condurre studi approfonditi su questo fenomeno inspiegabile, ma necessiterebbe della borsa di studio che gli è stata negata. Decide comunque di partire, accompagnato da Jana, ex collega e figlia del rettore dell'università in cui lavora. Ad attendere i due, un mistero da svelare e i fantasmi del loro passato in comune.

programme.title: Bergman 100: La Vita, I Segreti, Il Genio
programme.desc: Il documentario ricostruisce un anno fondamentale nella vita di Ingmar Bergman, il maestro del cinema, focalizzandosi sugli eventi che segnarono la sua carriera, tra l'uscita di Il posto delle fragole e Il settimo sigillo. Un viaggio nella sua arte, i suoi segreti e il suo genio creativo.

programme.title: Di là dal Fiume
programme.desc: La vita crea molti ostacoli per il ragazzo di 12 anni - Tedo. Tedo appartiene alla generazione che è stata costretta allo sfollamento di massa a causa della guerra civile in Abkhazia, uno dei luoghi più belli della Georgia. La guerra civile ha portato via tutto ciò che aveva Tedo, anche la speranza. Il film racconta uno straordinario dramma interiore di un bambino, i suoi pensieri, sentimenti, passioni, dolori e sforzi per prendere le armi contro le difficoltà.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler e suo marito Greg stanno cercando di trovare la scuola elementare giusta per il loro figlio di 4 anni, Jake. Descritto come gender-expansive dal suo consulente, il comportamento sempre più irregolare di Jake inizia a causare una spaccatura tra la coppia. Alex teme che gli adulti della sua vita lo stiano etichettando prematuramente, mentre Greg si chiede se la passione di Jake per i travestimenti non sia solo una fase.

programme.title: Love shooting
programme.desc: Charlie è un produttore cinematografico che si lascia convincere a realizzare un film su Benjamin Disraeli, a patto che il protagonista sia un attore di grande fama che però verrà rapito, costringendo Charlie ad escogitare una soluzione creativa.

programme.title: Souvenir d'italie
programme.desc: La storia di tre turiste straniere: l'inglese Margaret, la francese Josette e la tedesca Hilde che passano la frontiera con l'Italia per visitare il nostro Paese ma un incidente alla loro macchina le costringerà ad arrangiarsi con mezzi di fortuna.

programme.title: Alex & Emma
programme.desc: Alex è uno scrittore pieno di debiti. Deve scrivere un romanzo entro un mese per avere il denaro con cui saldarli. Contatta la stenografa Emma per aiutarlo nell'impresa. Tra i due si instaura un rapporto che va oltre quello professionale.

programme.title: Un Piccolo Grande Eroe
programme.desc: La storia di Alan, adolescente malato di poliomelite che desidera cavalcare e ha come mito personale il west e i cowboy. Dai racconti dell'australiano Allan Marshall, un film sulla giovinezza e su quanti ancora ne custodiscono in cuore il segreto.

programme.title: American Carnage
programme.desc: Una nuova legge permette l' arresto dei figli di immigrati irregolari. Per evitare il carcere i giovani hanno una sola opportunità: fare volontariato in una misteriosa casa di cura fornendo assistenza agli anziani.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: The reach: Caccia all'uomo
programme.desc: Ben (Jeremy Irvine) è un ragazzo di 25 anni idealista e innamorato della Natura. Conosce il deserto del Nevada come nessun altro e per professione accompagna i turisti attraverso quelle lande tanto solitarie quanto piene di pericoli.

programme.title: Amore inaspettato
programme.desc: Bill, scrittore di successo, resta cieco a causa di un incidente stradale, nel quale sua moglie perde la vita. Un giorno si presenta alla sua porta Suzanne, obbligata ai servizi sociali a causa di una condanna penale. All'inizio i due non si piacciono, ma ben presto si scopriranno innamorati.

programme.title: American Skin
programme.desc: Il colore della pelle, in America, conta. Conta eccome. Se sei nero. Lincoln Jefferson è un veterano del corpo dei Marines e lavora come custode in un prestigioso liceo della California: un lavoro che si è trovato per garantire l'iscrizione alla scuola del figlio quattordicenne, KJ.

programme.title: Daybreakers L'ultimo vampiro
programme.desc: Un'epidemia ha trasformato quasi tutti gli umani in vampiri, costringendo i pochi superstiti a nascondersi. Edward Dalton, un vampiro che rifiuta il sangue umano, lavora per creare un'alternativa sintetica e salvare l'umanità con l'aiuto della sopravvissuta Audrey.

programme.title: Una voce nella notte
programme.desc: Uno speaker radiofonico riceve strane telefonate da un ragazzo misterioso. Ma dietro la voce si nasconde un segreto inquietante. Thriller psicologico con Robin Williams.

programme.title: The 2nd
programme.desc: Quando un gruppo di terroristi attacca il campus per rapire la figlia di un giudice, Vic Davis, ex agente delle Forze Speciali, deve affrontare un pericolo mortale. La sua missione? Proteggere suo figlio e sventare un complotto che potrebbe cambiare tutto.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: Quando l'agente dell'FBI Roy Clayton dirige le indagini riguardanti una pericolosa cospirazione internazionale, tutti gli indizi sembrano ricondurre all'ex ufficiale delle operazioni speciali americane Samir Horn.

programme.title: L'amore in equilibrio
programme.desc: Refugio, sognatore cresciuto in un circo tra magia e poesia, parte dal Messico verso New Orleans alla ricerca del vero amore. L'incontro con Kay, ballerina dal passato oscuro, e con Juan, il padre che non sapeva di avere, intreccia destini, segreti e redenzione in un viaggio di speranza e passione.

programme.title: L'ultimo regalo
programme.desc: Un miliardario defunto lascia al suo viziato nipote adulto una serie di strani compiti da svolgere per ricevere "il regalo finale", con il nipote risentito che non ha idea di cosa potrebbe essere.

programme.title: Sotto il segno dell'amore
programme.desc: Kelsey lavora per una rivista e per scrivere un articolo sulla visione scettica dell'amore e degli oroscopi collabora con Carter, un maestro dell'astrologia. Nonostante provengano da mondi opposti, i due scoprono che l'amore può davvero essere scritto nelle stelle.

programme.title: Innamorarsi a Big Sky, Montana
programme.desc: Paisley ha il sogno di trasformare il suo ranch in un luogo di speranza e guarigione per bambini. Quando la banca le nega il finanziamento necessario, il destino le fa incontrare l'ultima persona che si sarebbe aspettata di vedere: il suo affascinante ex fidanzato, Josh, che, con le sue competenze e il suo desiderio di aiutarla, potrebbe essere l'unica persona in grado di salvare il ranch.

programme.title: Innamorarsi a Crystal Bay
programme.desc: Tilly lavora in un'associazione senza scopo di lucro e finalmente riesce a seguire un progetto a lei caro: salvare i pinguini. Per realizzarlo, collabora con lo zoologo Fletcher Grant, con il quale non è sempre d'accordo, ma lavorando a stretto contatto i due entrano sempre di più in sintonia.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da salvare
programme.desc: Jess e Max sono pronti ad annullare il loro matrimonio per lo stress eccessivo causato dal l'organizzazione fuori controllo dell'evento e da tutto quello che ne è conseguito. Ormai alla frutta, si recano da Billie, una dolce 'sempre damigella d'onore' che ha un'associazione no-profit che si occupa di donare alle persone meno abbienti e con bisogni speciali, allestimenti di feste di matrimonio già pagati e mai avvenuti. Tuttavia, Charlie, il fratello di Max, non si fermerà davanti a nulla pur di tenere insieme Jess e Max e per fare ciò, chiede aiuto a Billie, allettandola con un aiuto extra per la sua attività.

programme.title: Un amore indimenticabile
programme.desc: Lillian è una donna d'affari che trasforma start‑up in aziende di successo. Il suo nuovo cliente è una società chiamata ‘Love Subscription'. Il dolore amoroso del passato di Lillian entrerà in conflitto con i sentimenti che prova per Grant, il fondatore di Love Subscription?

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Parodia delle commedie romantiche che si concentra su una donna, il suo amante, i suoi genitori e suo padre.

programme.title: Assassini nati
programme.desc: Due persone con un passato difficile si innamorano e diventano spietati serial killer, ottenendo una temeraria ammirazione dai media.

programme.title: Dangerous Beauty
programme.desc: Alla fine del 1500, come amanti degli uomini importanti di Venezia, le donne avevano uno stile di vita regale ed erano incoraggiate a leggere e a studiare in un periodo in cui l'istruzione era proibita per la maggior parte delle donne.

programme.title: Abbasso l'amore
programme.desc: Quando un giornalista di una rivista per uomini, donnaiolo e uomo di successo, incontra una popolare autrice femminista con un'agenda segreta tutta sua, una classica battaglia dei sessi ad alto tasso di sfiga si svolge fino al suo atteso lieto fine.

programme.title: Istantanee
programme.desc: La figlia di un matematico brillante ma mentalmente disturbato, scomparso di recente, cerca di fare i conti con la sua possibile eredità: la sua follia. A complicare le cose ci sono un ex studente del padre, che vuole frugare tra i suoi documenti, e la sorella, che si era allontanata da lui.

programme.title: Breath
programme.desc: Una giovane madre in crisi coniugale s'innamora di un detenuto condannato a morte. Riesce ad incontrarlo nel parlatorio, sconvolgendo i suoi sentimenti e suscitando reazioni nei suoi compagni di cella. Intanto scorrono le stagioni fino a che il marito di lei li scopre e cerca di separarli.

programme.title: Knight of cups
programme.desc: Il padre era solito leggere al figlio Rick (Christian Bale), ancora ragazzino, questa storia: “C'era una volta un giovane principe che il padre inviò in Egitto a cercare una perla. Ma, quando il principe arrivò, la gente gli porse una coppa.

programme.title: Il ritorno
programme.desc: Teresa vive con Pietro e il piccolo Antonio, il figlio di due anni. Purtroppo la situazione economica, sociale e la poca affidabilità di Pietro costringono Teresa a compiere un gesto estremo per il quale finisce in carcere per dieci anni.

programme.title: In fuga per la libertà
programme.desc: Una coppia lascia Budapest a causa del regime, ma è costretta ad abbandonare Suzanne, la figlia minore. Anni dopo, la ragazza si riunisce alla famiglia, ma fatica ad adattarsi negli Stati Uniti. Solo un viaggio in Ungheria le farà riscoprire il vero significato di libertà e casa.

programme.title: The Kelly Gang
programme.desc: L'ascesa e la caduta del famigerato bandito australiano Ned Kelly. La storia del giovane fuorilegge che riunì un gruppo di guerriglieri per organizzare una ribellione contro i soprusi dell'impero britannico.

programme.title: Innamorarsi sul ghiaccio
programme.desc: Un giocatore professionista di hockey e la proprietaria di un negozio di libri si trovano a collaborare per rinnovare la propria immagine e il proprio stile di comunicazione. I due si rendono presto conto di quanto gli opposti si attraggano.

programme.title: Il primo raccolto
programme.desc: Una donna trova l'amore con un affascinante locale quando torna a casa per aiutare suo padre con il vigneto di famiglia.

programme.title: Il fiume delle verità
programme.desc: Un giovane abbandona la famiglia per una vita solitaria di pesca a mosca. Il suo obiettivo era trovare la propria strada nel mondo della pesca e quindi ritrovare se stesso e l'amore.

programme.title: Il sapore dellamore
programme.desc: Per salvare il ristorante sul lago di suo padre, una talentuosa designer d'interni deve collaborare con il famoso chef che suo padre ha assunto a sua insaputa per rinnovare il posto prima che scada il tempo.

programme.title: Un Matrimonio Da Salvare
programme.desc: Billie è l'affascinante proprietaria di una società di donazioni di matrimoni. I suoi clienti, Max e Jess, annullano il matrimonio. Billie e Charlie, i fratelli di Max, dovranno lavorare insieme per far sposare questa coppia.

programme.title: Il Segreto del suo Volto
programme.desc: Giugno 1945. Ferita, con il volto sfigurato, sopravvissuta ad Auschwitz, Nelly torna a Berlino. Guarita a malapena dall'intervento chirurgico al volto, la donna cerca il marito Johnny, l'amore della sua vita. Quando casualmente Nelly ritrova Johnny, lui non la riconosce. L'intervento l'ha resa quasi irriconoscibile. Eppure notando in lei una vaga somiglianza con la moglie, le chiede di assumerne l'identità, sperando così di mettere le mani sull'eredità della famiglia di lei. Nelly accetta. Vuole capire se Johnny l'ama ancora o se l'ha tradita, come sostiene la sua amica. Nelly rivuole la sua vita.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: The Artist
programme.desc: Un divo del muto cade in disgrazia con l'invenzione del sonoro. Verrà salvato dall'amore di una sua fan.L'evento in bianco e nero che ha conquistato Cannes.

programme.title: Lola + Jeremy
programme.desc: Jeremy, 27 anni, è un graphic designer e con il suo amico Mathias gestisce l'agenzia Cercasi alibi disperatamente per creare finti alibi tramite fatture, ricevute e scontrini per i fidanzati fedifraghi. Lola, 25 anni, lavora in una fumetteria ed è appassionata di supereroi e dei film di Michel Gondry, in particolare di “Se mi lasci ti cancello” che non si stanca mai di rivedere. Lola e Jeremy decidono di riprendere ogni momento della loro storia d'amore, per creare una sorta di video diario giornaliero da riguardare da lì a dieci anni. Lola, troppo curiosa, non resiste e si mette a guardarli subito da sola. Video dopo video, ne trova uno che non avrebbe dovuto vedere: Jeremy e i suoi amici stanno parlando proprio di lei, prim'ancora di conoscersi, e del progetto di Jeremy di girare un video diario da mostrare al padre in fin di vita in ospedale. Lola, delusa e ferita lascia Jeremy il cui solo scopo sarà, da quel momento, cercare di riconquistarla. Disperato pensa di mettere insieme un gruppo di strampalati supereroi, che rapiscono personaggi famosi. Il riscatto? Lola. E così le vie della periferia parigina si animano di una scalcagnata banda di eroi da fumetto, impegnati a organizzare impossibili e grotteschi rapimenti. Nel film tre piccoli camei, quello del regista Michel Gondry nella parte di se stesso, il batterista Manu Katché, per anni al fianco di Peter Gabriel e il rapper Youssoupha.

programme.title: È arrivata mia figlia!
programme.desc: Val, governante devota, vede il suo equilibrio cambiare quando la figlia Jessica arriva con le sue ambizioni. Un film vincitore al Berlinale e al Sundance che esplora temi di classe e disuguaglianza, con un'interpretazione straordinaria di Regina Casé.

programme.title: Jellyfish
programme.desc: Tra il bullismo a scuola, le angherie del suo prepotente capo alla sala giochi locale e il dover badare al fratello minore, alla sorella e alla madre maniaco-depressiva, la vita di Sarah Taylor non è facile. Mentre il suo amore per la commedia cresce e la vetrina si avvicina, il delicato equilibrio della sua vita diventa sempre più difficile da mantenere...

programme.title: La Comune
programme.desc: Erik e Anna, con la figlia Freja, creano una comune nella villa di famiglia a Copenhagen. Tra amicizie, feste e sogni condivisi, l'equilibrio viene spezzato da una relazione inaspettata che metterà alla prova il legame tra i membri della comunità.

programme.title: Fiori d'acciaio
programme.desc: Nella fittizia Chinquapin, Louisiana, si sta preparando un matrimonio. La sposa è Shelby (Julia Roberts) la cui madre (Sally Field), farebbe di tutto per lei.

programme.title: La Squadra Più Scassata Della Lega
programme.desc: La nuova proprietaria dei Cleveland Indians forma una squadra orribile per poterla spostare.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: Il lanciatore della lega minore Gus Cantrell sta per essere mandato in pensione quando riceve l'opportunità di fare la prossima cosa migliore: gestire i South Carolina Buzz. La squadra di baseball in difficoltà è piena di giocatori terribili, ma il proprietario Roger Dorn conta su Cantrell per trasformarli in una franchigia di prima classe.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Nella cittadina di Nelson il capo dei pompieri C.D. Bales ha il complesso del naso troppo lungo. Si innamora della bella e intelligente astronoma Roxanne, ma questa è attratta da un altro, Chris, un pompiere anche lui arrivato da poco. Roxanne confida il segreto a C.D. che informa Chris questi, esterrefatto, chiede a C.D. di scrivere una lettera per Roxanne a suo nome. C.D. accetta e l'inganno continua finché Roxanne non si innamora dell'uomo che le ha scritto quelle lettere appassionate...

programme.title: Le spie vengono dal semifreddo
programme.desc: Due portieri siciliani fermano il piano di Goldfoot per scatenare una guerra, ma finiscono prigionieri in Siberia

programme.title: Travolto dagli affetti familiari
programme.desc: Un uomo cerca di bilanciare un matrimonio d'interesse con l'affetto per nonna e cane

programme.title: Le inibizioni del dottor Gaudenzi vedovo col complesso della buonanima
programme.desc: Il dottor Gaudenzi, giura fedeltà eterna alla moglie morta, ma è perseguitato da incidenti con le donne

programme.title: Le favolose notti d'Oriente
programme.desc: Due lestofanti raccontano Le Mille e una notte erotiche per soddisfare lo sceicco e salvarsi la vita.

programme.title: Quel fantasma di mio marito
programme.desc: Un uomo, ucciso in un incidente, ritorna come un "fantasma" per aiutare la sua moglie a superare il dolore della sua morte e a trovare la felicità. Una commedia che gioca su spirito e sentimenti in modo divertente e malinconico.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Fifa e arena
programme.desc: Commedia di Mario Mattoli con Totò e Isa Barzizza: per un equivoco Nicolino è scambiato per un criminale e fugge a Siviglia. Tra gag, travestimenti e corrida, combinano guai esilaranti in una Spagna tutta napoletana.

programme.title: House Broken
programme.desc: Un uomo, per godersi la meritata pensione, decide di mandare via di casa i figli, disoccupati e scansafatiche.

programme.title: Arrivano i dollari
programme.desc: Cinque fratelli scoprono che uno zio morto in Sudafrica ha lasciato loro in eredità una grossa somma. Ma solo liberandosi dei loro difetti potranno entrarne in possesso. Tutti cercano allora di mettersi in buona luce con la bellissima moglie dello zio cercando di ingannarla.

programme.title: Sotto Il Cielo Delle Hawaii
programme.desc: Un famoso militare professionista ritorna sul luogo dei suoi più grandi trionfi legati al programma spaziale degli Stati Uniti a Honolulu, Hawaii. Qui incontra una sua ex, ma altrettanto inaspettatamente si innamora della giovane pilota dell'Air Force a lui assegnata.

programme.title: L'Uomo Che Sapeva Troppo Poco
programme.desc: Bill Murray è un americano imbranato che, mentre è in vacanza a Londra in visita al fratello, partecipa a un programma di 'virtual reality'. Quando crede che un vero tentativo di assassinio faccia parte del gioco, si trova per sbaglio immischiato in un caso di scambio d'identità e omicidio.

programme.title: Totò, Fabrizi e i giovani d'oggi
programme.desc: Il cavalier Cocozza e il ragionier D'Amore hanno in comune solo una parlantina inarrestabile e una potente vocazione polemica. I due, acerrimi nemici, negano il consenso alle nozze dei loro figli che le proveranno tutte per riuscire a sposarsi. Ci riusciranno?

programme.title: The Knight Of Shadows
programme.desc: Pu Songling è un leggendario cacciatore di demoni a cui viene chiesto di indagare sulle sparizioni di alcune ragazze del villaggio. Quando scopre che i crimini sono stati commessi da delle entità malvagie, Pu Songling combatte contro i demoni.

programme.title: La miliardaria
programme.desc: Epifania ha ereditato da suo padre una fortuna favolosa e un consiglio sul tipo di uomo da sposare. Lei, invece, si sposa senza seguire il consiglio di suo padre, ma il matrimonio si rivela un fallimento.

programme.title: LErba Di Grace
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di salvare la sua proprietà, Grace, una vedova inglese, decide di collaborare con un giardiniere e trasformare la serra di orchidee in una coltivazione di marijuana.

programme.title: 3 donne al verde
programme.desc: Tre donne organizzano la rapina più improbabile del Paese: rubare milioni di dollari in banconote destinate ogni giorno al tritadocumenti della banca più sicura degli Stati Uniti d'America. Prendere il denaro sarà facile... ma riusciranno a scappare?

programme.title: Se Permetti Non Parlarmi Di Bambini
programme.desc: Da quando si è separato, Gabriel non ha fatto altro che pensare a sua figlia Sofia. Un giorno si presenta al suo negozio di musica Vicky, una donna del suo passato, oggi più affascinante che mai, a cui però non piacciono i bambini.

programme.title: Tharus figlio di Attila
programme.desc: Tra invasioni, vendette e battaglie epiche, il figlio di Attila sfida nemici e tradimenti per difendere il suo popolo

programme.title: I sette gladiatori
programme.desc: Un grande film d'avventura con scontri fino all'ultimo sangue. Il gladiatore Dario, libero grazie alle sue vittorie, torna in patria. Qui, al posto del padre che vi governava, trova un tiranno usurpatore che l'ha ucciso. Con l'aiuto di sei validi combattenti, cercherà di rimettere tutto al proprio posto.

programme.title: I dieci gladiatori
programme.desc: Dieci guerrieri vengono scelti per una missione decisiva tra duelli, intrighi e battaglie che possono cambiare il destino di Roma.

programme.title: Sandokan alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: Sandokan contro il leopardo di Sarawak
programme.desc: Tra giungle e mari esotici, Sandokan sfida il temibile Leopardo di Sarawak in una lotta tra vendetta e libertà, tra duelli e battaglie spettacolari.

programme.title: Il tempo degli avvoltoi
programme.desc: Kitosch è accusato di un crimine che non ha commesso e si unisce a Joshua Tracy, un feroce fuorilegge. Quando Tracy rapisce e ricatta il suo ex datore di lavoro, Kitosch si riscatta salvandoli.

programme.title: Giubbe rosse
programme.desc: Cormack, l'uomo di legge più temuto dagli aspri pionieri all'inizio del secolo, ha un legame misterioso con "Caribou", un fuorilegge che ha imprigionato. Quando Caribou evade dalla prigione, ritorna per cercare vendetta.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: Tombstone è oppressa dai cinque fratelli O'Hara. Il pistolero Burt Collins arriva e accetta di diventare sceriffo per fermarli. Nell'ombra agisce l'enigmatico avvocato James Webb, pronto a intervenire con i suoi micidiali “libri di diritto”.

programme.title: Uno sceriffo tutto d'oro
programme.desc: Un uomo armato si allea con un piccolo sceriffo per rapinare un carico d'oro.

programme.desc: Gwen sposa Torito e lo segue. Rapita da una tribù rivale, fugge grazie a un cowboy.

programme.title: I tre del Colorado
programme.desc: Per contrastare i soprusi degli inglesi, la popolazione locale cattura la figlia di un industriale.

programme.title: Faccia a faccia

programme.title: Il mio nome è Scopone e faccio sempre cappotto
programme.desc: Dallas e Kelly, in gara per un ranch, affrontano i fratelli Wright e altri rivali.

programme.title: Viva Gringo
programme.desc: Degli emissari peruviani negoziano la pace con gli Incas, ma un bandito li incolpa per il delitto del sovrano.

programme.desc: Anni '70, Corea sotto la dittatura di Park. Kim Jae-gyoo, suo uomo più fidato, scopre un servizio segreto che risponde solo al presidente. Il senso di tradimento cresce fino a trasformare la lealtà in antagonismo.
